description: Flashpoint. Still no danger to the player in 1c — the danger arrives in 1d and stages on top of this same cell state.
name: Something is burning

stage.text: Glass goes, somewhere off to one side, and nobody shouts about it.

lines: A bin is burning in the mouth of the alley and nobody is watching it.
Smoke goes across the street at knee height and smells like a solvent.
The pavement is glass from wall to kerb and people are walking on it anyway.

stage.text: It has properly gone off in {place}. I wouldn't walk it tonight, not for money.
A minor fire in {place} has been contained — the cause is under review and there's no risk to Basin infrastructure.
